skill.name: planning-with-files
skill.description: Adds file-based planning workflows for complex AI tasks. It guides agents to create task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md for persistent context.
skill.summary: Use markdown planning files to organize long, multi-step AI work.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, benign shell status checks, and workflow template language. No prompt injection or network exfiltration evidence was found, but the Stop hook can block session exit and the PreToolUse hook prints planning file content.

remediation.issue: Stop hook can block session exit
remediation.suggestion: Change the Stop hook to warn without exiting nonzero, or require explicit user approval before blocking closure.

remediation.issue: PreToolUse hook prints planning file content automatically
remediation.suggestion: Make the file preview opt-in or redact sensitive sections before printing task_plan.md into hook output.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts are installed with Bash hooks
remediation.suggestion: Document each hook command and keep scripts read-only, quoted, and limited to local planning files.

semantic_findings.title: Stop Hook Can Block Session Exit
semantic_findings.description: The skill configures a Stop hook to run check-complete.sh. The script exits with failure and tells the agent not to stop when the plan has incomplete phases.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The hook and script logic directly show nonzero exit behavior on incomplete plans. This is an availability and user-control risk, not a data exfiltration risk.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Planning File Preview
semantic_findings.description: The PreToolUse hook prints the first lines of task_plan.md before Write, Edit, and Bash use. This can expose local planning notes in repeated hook output.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The hook command explicitly cats task_plan.md and pipes it to head. The scope is local and limited, so severity is low.

content.value_statement: Long AI tasks can lose goals, discoveries, and test results as context grows. This skill uses persistent markdown files to keep plans, findings, and progress visible.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md in the project directory.
Provides templates for phased plans, findings, progress logs, tests, and error tracking.
Uses hooks to remind agents to update plans after file changes.
Includes scripts to initialize planning files and check phase completion.
Encourages periodic re-reading of planning files during long tasks.
limitations: It does not complete tasks automatically; it organizes the work.
Hooks and scripts require environments that support skill hooks and Bash.
Planning files may need manual cleanup before committing to a repository.
It can add overhead for short or single-step requests.

use_cases.title: Coordinate implementation phases
use_cases.description: Break a feature into discovery, implementation, testing, and delivery files that survive long sessions.

use_cases.title: Track research evidence
use_cases.description: Save sources, findings, decisions, and open questions while moving between searches and documents.

use_cases.title: Resume interrupted work
use_cases.description: Rebuild task context from plan, findings, and progress files after breaks or agent restarts.

prompt_templates.title: Start a file plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-files for this task. Create task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md before you begin.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a feature build
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-files to break this feature into phases. Record assumptions in findings.md and update progress.md after each phase.

prompt_templates.title: Research and synthesize
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-files for this research project. Save key sources in findings.md, then convert findings into a phased delivery plan.

prompt_templates.title: Resume a long task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-files to resume this project. Read existing planning files, identify stale decisions, update phase status, and continue safely.

output_examples.input: Start a complex feature request with planning files.
output_examples.output: The agent creates a phased task plan, records initial requirements, and opens a progress log before implementation.

output: Reads the plan to identify the current phase.
Updates progress with the next verified action.

output_examples.input: Finish a task with incomplete phases.
output_examples.output: The skill reports unfinished phases and prompts the agent to complete or update the plan before closing.

best_practices: Create planning files in the project root, not inside the skill directory.
Update findings immediately after searches, document reviews, or major discoveries.
Keep error entries concise, with the failed attempt and the final resolution.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for a quick answer or one-line edit.
Recording sensitive credentials or private customer data in planning files.
Letting status fields drift away from the actual work completed.

faq.question: What files does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides creation of task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md in the current project.

faq.question: Does it require Bash?
faq.answer: The planning method is markdown-based, but included helper hooks and scripts use Bash.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for small tasks?
faq.answer: Usually no. It is best for tasks with several phases or many tool calls.

faq.question: Where should planning files be stored?
faq.answer: Store them beside the project files so they travel with the work context.

faq.question: Can planning files contain sensitive data?
faq.answer: They can if the agent records it. Review them before sharing or committing the repository.
